entities.summary: The Nishitetsu Amagi Line  is a Japanese railway line operated by the private railway operator Nishi-Nippon Railroad (Nishitetsu), which connects Miyanojin Station, Kurume and Amagi Station, Asakura in Fukuoka Prefecture.
